subject.title: fix(slack): time out stalled external file uploads

question: Should OpenClaw support `PlatformMessageNotDispatchedError` as a public plugin SDK contract that lets channel adapters declare failed sends safe for durable replay?
rationale: The Slack fix is correct, but the reusable API gives external plugins authority over duplicate-delivery safety and creates a lasting compatibility commitment that automation cannot accept for maintainers.

options.title: Accept the narrow public contract
options.body: Support the class only for adapter-owned failures before any finalization-capable call, then land after rebase and exact-head validation.

options.title: Keep replay authority internal
options.body: Retain a Slack/core-private signal and defer third-party replay assertions until maintainers intentionally design that plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow public contract
recommendation.body: Support the class only for adapter-owned failures before any finalization-capable call, then land after rebase and exact-head validation.
